hook_text: A finished box hides everything inside. One drawing shows it all without a screwdriver.
clip_script: Draw a faint vertical line. Base at the bottom, drawn in isometric. Battery holder above it. Circuit board above that with its little parts. Lid above that, LED and button popping out of their holes. Four screws floating over their holes. Thin dashed lines through all of them, down the axis. Every part stays the right way up. Balloon numbers from the base up. A parts list that matches, with material and size. Title block, a note that says solder before fitting. Then the test: could a stranger put it together from this? That is the exploded view, and it is your assembly plan for building week.
visual_style: Whiteboard isometric stack appearing part by part along a dashed axis; balloons numbering 1 to 8; a parts list table; a tick.
mood: Visual and satisfying, like watching a kit assemble itself in reverse.
pacing: Axis, base, holder, board, lid, LED, screws, lines, balloons, list, test.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw an exploded view of a torch: cap, lens, bulb, cells, body.
